summary: Shows math filters (1.9+): log (natural or base), pow, and root (square or nth), with Jinja2 providing abs and round.
questions: How do I calculate a logarithm or square root in an Ansible template?
How do I raise a number to a power in Jinja2?

answer_card.title: Math filters
answer_card.answer_md:
```jinja
{{ 8 | log }}       # natural log
{{ 8 | log(10) }}   # base 10
{{ 8 | pow(5) }}    # 32768.0
{{ 8 | root }}      # square root
{{ 8 | root(5) }}   # 5th root
```

Jinja2 also provides `abs()` and `round()`.
